pedagogy.learner_rule: Do not advance because a command ran; advance when you can explain what the output means and what it does not prove.

shared_core.title: Orientação e contrato epistemológico
shared_core.checkpoint: Explain why a tool output is not automatically a conclusion.

shared_core.title: Preservar antes de interpretar
shared_core.checkpoint: Record the SHA-256 before analysis and explain what hashing proves and does not prove.

shared_core.title: Criar a primeira timeline
shared_core.checkpoint: Find one event_id and trace it back to source, timestamp and record locator.

missions.title: Triage sem veredito
missions.checkpoint: Identify the highest-priority event and state one benign alternative explanation.

missions.title: Correlação temporal explicável
outcomes: interpret same_host same_user same_pid and time-window reasons
missions.checkpoint: Choose one correlation and list the exact rules that created it.

missions.title: Hipótese forense concorrente
missions.checkpoint: Produce one hypothesis with at least two cited events and one plausible alternative.

missions.title: Extrair sem inventar
missions.checkpoint: Explain the difference between observed text, normalized entity and verified identity.

missions.title: Grafo de coocorrência
missions.checkpoint: Find one graph edge and describe only what the edge proves.

missions.title: GLiNER opcional e corroborado
missions.checkpoint: Find or explain a case where two extractors can support the same mention without proving identity.

missions.title: Unificar host e contexto aberto
outcomes: keep event and entity nodes distinct
combine temporal correlation with grounded mentions
missions.checkpoint: Identify one host event and one entity mention that share context without claiming causality.

missions.title: Evidence Packet v2
missions.checkpoint: List three fields deliberately excluded from the AI boundary or explain why exclusion matters.

missions.title: Raciocínio assistido e auditável
outcomes: distinguish reported confidence from calibrated support
missions.checkpoint: Review one claim and verify every cited event_id manually.

missions.title: Capstone: relatório de primeira investigação
missions.checkpoint: Deliver a concise case note with observations, one inference, one hypothesis, one alternative and next question.

completion.track_rule: Complete all non-optional missions in one track.
completion.academy_rule: A learner is complete when they can defend provenance, citations, uncertainty and the limits of correlation.
